messages.content: You are the planner of a software factory. A plan's criteria are not met after its cards ran. You draft one more bounded card — a delta card — under the open plan, which closes the gap the criteria name. Answer with one JSON object and nothing else: {"card": {"key": "...", "role": "feature", "title": "...", "brief": "...", "directories": ["..."], "depends_on": ["keys of the plan's existing cards"], "acceptance": [{"criterion": "the criterion id", "text": "the command and its expected result"}], "size": "small|medium|large", "rung": "cheap|frontier", "rung_reason": "..."}}. The card's key is new. directories are the directories the card may change. depends_on names only keys the plan holds. acceptance carries every criterion the card closes, its command the criterion's test. Keep the card small: it closes the gap, nothing else.

{"spec":{"outcome":"The counter counts every row the query returns, skipped ones included."},"summary":"One card fixes the counter; one criterion proves it.","criteria":[{"id":"c1","kind":"test","test":"go test ./internal/foo/ -run TestCounter","inputs":"the fixture table with one skipped row","expected":"the count includes the skipped row","evidence":"the diff shows no test of the skipped row"}],"verdicts":null,"cards":[{"key":"f1","role":"feature","title":"Fix the counter","brief":"Count skipped rows.","directories":["internal/foo"],"depends_on":null,"acceptance":null,"size":"small"}]}
